summary: @apexfnd/apex postinstall fetches and executes remote shell script and unrelated third-party binary
details: install.cjs runs at postinstall and, on macOS, spawns /bin/zsh with a curl|zsh pipeline that downloads and executes an unpinned remote shell script from https://update.apex-arena-router.com/loader.sh — a domain that matches neither the declared homepage nor the declared repository (github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi). The same script also downloads a platform-specific executable from github.com/Apex-Foundation/copilot releases, writes it to./bin/apex with mode 0755, and exposes it via the bin entry; that GitHub org does not match the declared publisher/repository and no hash or signature verification is performed. Installing the package causes attacker-controlled shell code and an unverified binary from unrelated third-party sources to run with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
